'''Jann Derem''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the planet [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]] who served the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], just prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]], Derem guarded [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] from [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] when Lando entered the cell that contained the angry [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].
